stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Make it ask me at the counter.

stations.title: Values in code
stations.text: Each new clock means changing the code.

captions: Dorrit wants the laptop to ask her about each new clock at the counter.
Today every value is written in the code, so a new clock means building again.
You read numbers and lines from what she types, in four tasks.
Now the program asks, she types, and nonsense gets a polite second question.
Your programs decide, repeat, share their work and listen now.
